title: Constraint-Aware Anticlustering Decomposition for Certifying Pairwise-Constrained Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2611.27496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Certifying the quality of feasible solutions to large-scale minimum sum-of-squares clustering with pairwise must-link and cannot-link constraints remains challenging, as it requires strong lower bounds on the optimal objective value. We propose a decomposition framework that partitions the data points into smaller subsets, called anticlusters, and solves the induced clustering subproblems to obtain a certified optimality gap for the original problem. To preserve pairwise information, we introduce the Constrained Anticlustering Problem (CAP), which assigns each connected component of the constraint graph to a single anticluster while seeking geometrically representative subsets. We formulate CAP as a mixed-integer second-order cone program and develop a variable neighborhood search heuristic to construct high-quality decompositions. translated_title: 面向成对约束聚类认证的约束感知反聚类分解
translated_abstract: 对于带有成对必须连接与不能连接约束的大规模最小平方和聚类问题，认证其可行解的质量仍然具有挑战性，因为这需要对最优目标值有较强的下界。我们提出了一个分解框架，将数据点划分为更小的子集（称为反聚类），并求解由此产生的聚类子问题，从而为原问题获得认证的最优性间隙。为了保留成对约束信息，我们引入了约束反聚类问题（CAP），该问题将约束图的每个连通分量分配给单个反聚类，同时寻求几何上具有代表性的子集。我们将CAP表述为混合整数二阶锥规划，并开发了变量邻域搜索启发式算法来构建高质量的分解。即使诱导出的子问题未被求解至全局最优，所得的下界依然有效。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种约束感知的反聚类分解框架，通过引入约束反聚类问题（CAP）并构建为混合整数二阶锥规划模型，将约束图的连通分量分配到反聚类中，从而为带成对约束的大规模最小平方和聚类问题提供有效的认证下界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a constraint-aware anticlustering decomposition framework that introduces the Constrained Anticlustering Problem (CAP), formulated as a mixed-integer second-order cone program, to assign connected components of the constraint graph to anticlusters, thereby providing valid certified lower bounds for large-scale pairwise-constrained minimum sum-of-squares clustering.
